text: If at home you have a carpet on the floor, quality wooden parquet, or tactilely pleasant tile — periodically perform a simple sensory practice: walk barefoot for literally 5 minutes. Walk slowly, feeling the texture under your foot. For a better effect, you can first knead your feet with your hands or a massage roller — so that you feel life in them, and pleasure from touching the floor. This technique returns attention to the body and reduces anxiety. For the first chakra, the feet are like antennas. Keep them in a revived state.
